## Reynolds Consumer Products Declares Regular Quarterly Cash Dividend


April 30, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com/node/10386/pdf)


LAKE FOREST, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 30, 2026-- Reynolds Consumer Products Inc. (Nasdaq: REYN) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per common share. The dividend is payable May 29, 2026, to shareholders of record as of May 15, 2026.


**About Reynolds Consumer Products Inc.**


Reynolds Consumer Products is a leading provider of household essentials designed to simplify daily life, so consumers can enjoy what matters most. Found in 95% of U.S. homes, the Company offers trusted solutions for cooking, cleanup, food storage, and more. Its portfolio features iconic brands like Reynolds Wrap® aluminum foil and Hefty® trash bags and disposable tableware, along with store brand products tailored to retail partners. Reynolds holds the No. 1 or No. 2 U.S. market share in most of the categories it serves. Learn more at:[investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com%2F&esheet=54526417&newsitemid=20260430544958&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com&index=1&md5=b0e83dca955701815711cdbc30007545)
